简单的通量开发工作流程，作者：weshouldhaveshotguns

此工作流程旨在提供一种直接、直观的方法来在 ComfyUI 中使用 Flux Dev。我的目标是创建一个不仅运行良好的设置，还可以帮助用户了解每个节点的功能及其存在的原因，使他们更容易自行定制和实验。

该工作流程包括指向所有必需文件的链接、设置纲要以及解决方案和提示的最佳实践，以及有关 FluxGuidance、步骤和采样器等设置如何影响输出的指导。无论您是 AI 艺术新手还是有一定经验，此工作流程都将为您在 Flux 方面打下坚实的基础，使您能够快速精通，甚至掌握一些中级技巧。这不是最终的工作流程——总是有更多东西需要学习——但它经过了良好的优化、精心组织，并且是学习和创造的一个很好的起点。

v2 中的新功能:

  • LoRA 魔法解锁：v2 带来了 LoRA 支持电源 LoRA 加载器，让您添加自定义角色和风格调整。如果您敢的话，可以分层使用多个 LoRA，但要小心平衡它们。

    • 禁止的注释：避免组合两个 LoRA 角色，除非你想召唤一个“被诅咒的私生子”。一次坚持使用一个 LoRA 角色以获得最佳效果。

其他补充:

  • 舒适的管理器设置：添加了安装说明以方便设置。

  • 工作流程纲要升级：扩展了如何充分利用 Power LoRA Loader 的技巧。

为什么是v2？v2 为您提供了更多的创作自由和控制力，让您可以探索 LoRA，而无需使 Flux 工作流程变得过于复杂。

o.en:
SIMPLE FLUX DEV WORKFLOW by weshouldhaveshotguns

This workflow is designed to provide a straightforward, intuitive approach to using Flux Dev in ComfyUI. My goal was to create a setup that not only works well but also helps users understand what each node does and why it's there, making it easier for them to customize and experiment on their own.

The workflow includes links to all the required files, a settings rundown, and best practices for resolutions and prompts, with guidance on how settings like FluxGuidance, steps, and samplers influence output. Whether you're new to AI art or have some experience, this workflow will give you a solid foundation in Flux, enabling you to quickly become proficient and even pick up a few intermediate tips. It’s not the ultimate workflow—there’s always more to learn—but it’s well-optimized, thoughtfully organized, and a great starting point for both learning and creation.

New in v2:

  • LoRA Magic Unlocked: v2 brings LoRA support with aPower LoRA Loader, letting you add custom character and style tweaks. Layer multiple LoRAs if you dare, but balance them carefully.

    • Forbidden Note: Avoid combining two character LoRAs unless you want to summon a "cursed lovechild." Stick to one character LoRA at a time for best results.

Other Additions:

  • Comfy Manager Setup: Added installation instructions for an easy setup.

  • Workflow Rundown Upgrade: Expanded with tips on using the Power LoRA Loader to its fullest.

Why v2?v2 gives you more creative freedom and control, letting you explore LoRAs without overcomplicating the Flux workflow.
